master.definition_en: Bovine respiratory disease found in animals that have been shipped or exposed to cattle recently transported. The major agent responsible for the disease is mannheimia haemolytica and less commonly, pasteurella multocida or haemophilus somnus. All three agents are normal inhabitants of the bovine nasal pharyngeal mucosa but not the lung. They are considered opportunistic pathogens following stress, physiological and/or a viral infection. The resulting bacterial fibrinous bronchopneumonia is often fatal.

Signs and symptoms of dermatographia include raised red lines, swelling, inflammation, hive-like welts and itching. Symptoms usually disappear within 30 minutes. The exact cause of this condition is unknown. Treatment may involve use of antihistamines if symptoms do not go away on their own.

master.definition_en: Familial Renal Glucosuria (FRG) is characterized by the presence of persistent isolated glucosuria in the absence of both generalized proximal tubular dysfunction and hyperglycemia. FRG is usually considered a benign entity as most patients are not affected by severe clinical consequences. Polyuria and enuresis and later a mild growth and pubertal maturation delay are the only manifestations that have been reported during a follow-up period of 30 years. Episodic dehydration and ketosis during pregnancy and starvation and an increased incidence of urinary tract infections have occasionally been reported in severe cases. FRG is caused by loss-of-function mutations in the gene SLC5A2 (16p11.2).

master.name_en: coloboma, osteopetrosis, microphthalmia, macrocephaly, albinism, and deafness
master.definition_en: A rare syndromic optic nerve hypoplasia characterized by coloboma, osteopetrosis (particularly of the anterior ribs and femoral heads), severe microphthalmia, macrocephaly, albinism, and profound congenital deafness. Patients may also have additional eye anomalies including microcornea with pannus, dense bilateral cataracts, and translucent irides. Craniofacial dysmorphism (including frontal bossing, shallow orbits, preauricular pits, posteriorly rotated ears, micrognathia and wide palatine ridges) is also reported.

master.definition_en: A rare non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis characterized by multiple small yellowish-red or brown papules initially erupting predominantly in the head and neck region. The histopathological hallmark of these eventually self-healing lesions is a dermal proliferation of histiocytes with intracytoplasmic comma-shaped bodies, coated vesicles, and desmosome-like structures. Birbeck granules are absent. The disease typically occurs in young children.

master.definition_en: Familial primary hypomagnesemia with normocalciuria and normocalcemia (FPHNN) is a form of familial primary hypomagnesemia (FPH), characterized by low serum magnesium (Mg) values but inappropriate normal urinary Mg values (i.e. renal hypomagnesemia). master.definition_en: Hyperprolinemia is when there isan excess of a particular protein building block (amino acid), called proline, in the blood. This condition generally occurs when proline is not broken down properly by the body. There are two inherited forms:hyperprolinemia type1 and hyperprolinemia type 2. People with hyperprolinemia type I often do not show any symptoms, although they have proline levels in their blood between 3 and 10 times the normal level. Less commonly, affected individuals can experience seizures, intellectual disability, or other neurological or psychiatric problems. Hyperprolinemia is caused by mutations in the PRODH gene and is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern.

master.definition_en: Multifocal choroiditis (MFC) is an inflammatory disorder characterized by swelling of the eye (called uveitis) and multiple lesions in the choroid, a layer of blood vessels between the white of the eye and the retina. Symptoms include blurry vision, floaters, sensitivity to light, blind spots and mild eye discomfort. Though the cause is unknown, multifocal choroiditis is seen most frequently in women ages 20 to 60, and usually affects both eyes. MFC is generally treated with steroid medication that can be taken orally or injected into the eye. Multifocal choroiditis is a chronic condition, thus symptoms may return or worsen even after successful treatment.

Treatment with replacement Ig is effective; hematopoietic stem cell transplantation has also been reported.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A compression of ILIAC VEIN that results in a decreased flow in the vein and in the left LOWER EXTREMITY due to a vascular malformation. It may result in left leg EDEMA, pain, iliofemoral DEEP VENOUS THROMBOSIS and POSTTHROMBOTIC SYNDROME. Compression of the left common ILIAC VEIN by the right common ILIAC ARTERY against the underlying fifth LUMBAR VERTEBRA is the typical underlying malformation.

master.name_en: microcephaly, short stature, and limb abnormalities
master.definition_en: A rare genetic multiple congenital anomalies syndrome characterized by severe microcephaly, intrauterine growth retardation, short stature and variable limb anomalies such as radial ray defects, short limbs, absent/hypoplastic patellae, syndactyly, brachydactyly and hypoplastic carpal or metacarpal bones. Craniofacial dysmorphism is characterized by long and broad nose, microstomia and micrognathia. Intellectual disability is mild when present. Cases with extremely severe phenotype with very short limbs and poor lung development are perinatally lethal.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。
